sanskrit: abo̍dhy a̱gniḥ sa̱midhā̱ janā̍nā̱m prati̍ dhe̱num i̍vāya̱tīm u̱ṣāsa̍m | ya̱hvā i̍va̱ pra va̱yām u̱jjihā̍nā̱ḥ pra bhā̱nava̍ḥ sisrate̱ nāka̱m accha̍ ||
english: Agni has awakened through the fuel of the people, going forth to meet the Dawn as she approaches like a cow; the great ones like young birds spreading their wings, the rays stream upward toward the vault of heaven.

sanskrit: abo̍dhi̱ hotā̍ ya̱jathā̍ya de̱vān ū̱rdhvo a̱gniḥ su̱manā̍ḥ prā̱tar a̍sthāt | sami̍ddhasya̱ ruśa̍d adarśi̱ pājo̍ ma̱hān de̱vas tama̍so̱ nir a̍moci ||
english: The Hotṛ has awakened to sacrifice to the gods; Agni, well-disposed and erect, has stood up at dawn. The blazing might of him, when kindled, has been seen; the great god has been freed from darkness.

sanskrit: yad ī̍ṁ ga̱ṇasya̍ raśa̱nām ajī̍ga̱ḥ śuci̍r aṅkte̱ śuci̍bhi̱r gobhi̍r a̱gniḥ | ād dakṣi̍ṇā yujyate vāja̱yanty u̍ttā̱nām ū̱rdhvo a̍dhayaj ju̱hūbhi̍ḥ ||
english: When he takes the tether of the host, pure Agni adorns himself with pure rays of light; thereupon the dakṣiṇā, seeking the prize, is harnessed, and he who stands erect has drunk up the oblation with his tongues of flame.

sanskrit: a̱gnim acchā̍ devaya̱tām manā̍ṁsi̱ cakṣū̍ṁṣīva̱ sūrye̱ saṁ ca̍ranti | yad ī̱ṁ suvā̍te u̱ṣasā̱ virū̍pe śve̱to vā̱jī jā̍yate̱ agre̱ ahnā̍m ||
english: The minds of those who devoutly seek Agni converge toward him as eyes converge toward the sun; when the two differently-formed Dawns set him in motion, the white steed is born at the forefront of the days.

sanskrit: jani̍ṣṭa̱ hi jenyo̱ agre̱ ahnā̍ṁ hi̱to hi̱teṣv a̍ru̱ṣo vane̍ṣu | dame̍-dame sa̱pta ratnā̱ dadhā̍no̱ 'gnir hotā̱ ni ṣa̍sādā̱ yajī̍yān ||
english: He was born, the conqueror, at the head of the days, the ruddy one set among the fuels in the forests; Agni, the Hotṛ bearing seven treasures in house after house, most worthy of worship, has taken his seat.

sanskrit: a̱gnir hotā̱ ny a̍sīda̱d yajī̍yān u̱pasthe̍ mā̱tuḥ su̍ra̱bhā u̍ lo̱ke | yuvā̍ ka̱viḥ pu̍runi̱ṣṭha ṛ̱tāvā̍ dha̱rtā kṛ̍ṣṭī̱nām u̱ta madhya̍ i̱ddhaḥ ||
english: Agni, the Hotṛ most worthy of worship, has sat down in the lap of the mother, fragrant in the world; the young seer, much-requested, possessing Ṛta, the upholder of the peoples — he burns in their midst.

sanskrit: pra ṇu tyaṁ vipra̍m adhva̱reṣu̍ sā̱dhum a̱gniṁ hotā̍ram īḻate̱ namo̍bhiḥ | ā yas ta̱tāna̱ roda̍sī ṛ̱tena̱ nitya̍m mṛjanti vā̱jina̍ṁ ghṛ̱tena̍ ||
english: Even now men invoke with reverences that inspired and able Agni, the Hotṛ at the rites — he who has stretched both world-halves with Ṛta; they ever groom the prize-winner with ghee.

sanskrit: mā̱rjā̱lyo̍ mṛjyate̱ sve damū̍nāḥ kavipraśa̱sto ati̍thiḥ śi̱vo na̍ḥ | sa̱hasra̍śṛṅgo vṛṣa̱bhas tado̍jā̱ viśvā̍m̐ agne̱ saha̍sā̱ prāsy a̱nyān ||
english: He who belongs to the cleansing rite is groomed in his own home, praised by the seer, our beneficent guest; the bull of a thousand horns, whose strength is in that very power — O Agni, by your force you surpass all others.

sanskrit: pra sa̱dyo a̍gne̱ aty e̍ṣy a̱nyān ā̱vir yasmai̱ cāru̍tamo ba̱bhūtha̍ | ī̱ḻenyo̍ vapu̱ṣyo̍ vi̱bhāvā̍ pri̱yo vi̱śām ati̍thi̱r mānu̍ṣīṇām ||
english: Straightway, O Agni, you surpass all others, manifest to whomever you have become most dear; worthy of praise, of beautiful form, shining widely — the beloved guest of the clans of humankind.

sanskrit: tubhya̍m bharanti kṣi̱tayo̍ yaviṣṭha ba̱lim a̍gne̱ anti̍ta̱ ota dū̱rāt | ā bhandi̍ṣṭhasya suma̱tiṁ ci̍kiddhi bṛ̱hat te̍ agne̱ mahi̱ śarma̍ bha̱dram ||
english: The settled peoples bring tribute to you, O youngest Agni, both those nearby and those from afar; perceive the good will of him who offers most ardent praise — great and lofty is your shelter, O Agni, blessed and excellent.

sanskrit: ādya ratha̍m bhānumo bhānu̱manta̱m agne̱ tiṣṭha̍ yaja̱tebhi̱ḥ sama̍ntam | vi̱dvān pa̍thī̱nām u̱rv a1̱̍ntari̍kṣa̱m eha de̱vān ha̍vi̱radyā̍ya vakṣi ||
english: Mount today the radiant chariot, O Agni, surrounded on all sides by those worthy of worship; knowing the broad mid-air and its pathways, bring hither the gods to eat the oblation.

sanskrit: avo̍cāma ka̱vaye̱ medhyā̍ya̱ vaco̍ va̱ndāru̍ vṛṣa̱bhāya̱ vṛṣṇe̍ | gavi̍ṣṭhiro̱ nama̍sā̱ stoma̍m a̱gnau di̱vī̍va ru̱kmam u̍ru̱vyañca̍m aśret ||
english: We have spoken a word of homage to the wise and sacred seer, the bull and the mighty; Gaviṣṭhira has offered with reverence a hymn of praise into Agni — it has spread wide like a golden ornament in the sky.

sanskrit: ku̱mā̱ram mā̱tā yu̍va̱tiḥ samu̍bdha̱ṁ guhā̍ bibharti̱ na da̍dāti pi̱tre | anī̍kam asya̱ na mi̱naj janā̍saḥ pu̱raḥ pa̍śyanti̱ nihi̍tam ara̱tau ||
english: The young mother carries the boy, clasped close, in secret; she does not give him to the father. The people do not diminish his force; they see him placed in front, hidden in the fire-stick.

sanskrit: kam e̱taṁ tvaṁ yu̍vate kumā̱ram peṣī̍ bibharṣi̱ mahi̍ṣī jajāna | pū̱rvīr hi garbha̍ḥ śa̱rado̍ va̱vardhāpa̍śyaṁ jā̱taṁ yad asū̍ta mā̱tā ||
english: What is this boy, O young one, that you carry in your womb? The great queen has given birth to him. For the embryo has grown through many autumns — I saw the newborn when the mother brought him forth.

sanskrit: hira̍ṇyadanta̱ṁ śuci̍varṇam ā̱rāt kṣetrā̍d apaśya̱m āyu̍dhā̱ mimā̍nam | da̱dā̱no a̍smā a̱mṛta̍ṁ vi̱pṛkva̱t kim mām a̍ni̱ndrāḥ kṛ̍ṇavann anu̱kthāḥ ||
english: From afar I saw him measuring out his weapons in the field — of golden teeth and pure appearance; dispensing immortality to us, mingling it — what can those who are without Indra and their praises do to me?

sanskrit: kṣetrā̍d apaśyaṁ sanu̱taś cara̍ntaṁ su̱mad yū̱thaṁ na pu̱ru śobha̍mānam | na tā a̍gṛbhra̱nn aja̍niṣṭa̱ hi ṣaḥ pali̍knī̱r id yu̍va̱tayo̍ bhavanti ||
english: From the field I saw him moving at a distance, shining greatly like a herd in good shape; they did not grasp those — for he was born; those that were gray-haired become young women indeed.

sanskrit: ke me̍ marya̱kaṁ vi ya̍vanta̱ gobhi̱r na yeṣā̍ṁ go̱pā ara̍ṇaś ci̱d āsa̍ | ya ī̍ṁ jagṛ̱bhur ava̱ te sṛ̍ja̱ntv ājā̍ti pa̱śva upa̍ naś ciki̱tvān ||
english: Who would separate my darling from his cows — he whose herdsman had never been a stranger? Let those who seized him release him; the knowing one will drive the cattle back to us.

sanskrit: va̱sāṁ rājā̍naṁ vasa̱tiṁ janā̍nā̱m arā̍tayo̱ ni da̍dhu̱r martye̍ṣu | brahmā̱ṇy atre̱r ava̱ taṁ sṛ̍jantu nindi̱tāro̱ nindyā̍so bhavantu ||
english: The enemies have hidden the king who clothes the people, the dweller among mortals; let the prayers of Atri release him — may the slanderers themselves become worthy of blame.

sanskrit: śuna̍ś ci̱c chepa̱ṁ nidi̍taṁ sa̱hasrā̱d yūpā̍d amuñco̱ aśa̍miṣṭa̱ hi ṣaḥ | e̱vāsmad a̍gne̱ vi mu̍mugdhi̱ pāśā̱n hota̍ś cikitva i̱ha tū ni̱ṣadya̍ ||
english: Even Śunaḥśepa, bound to the thousand-post yūpa, was released — for he prayed. Even so, O Agni, release from us these fetters; O Hotṛ, knowing one, sit down here now.

sanskrit: hṛ̱ṇī̱yamā̍no̱ apa̱ hi mad aiye̱ḥ pra me̍ de̱vānā̍ṁ vrata̱pā u̍vāca | indro̍ vi̱dvām̐ anu̱ hi tvā̍ ca̱cakṣa̱ tenā̱ham a̍gne̱ anu̍śiṣṭa̱ āgā̍m ||
english: Being angered, the guardian of the divine ordinances spoke forth to me from afar — he turned away from me; Indra, the knowing one, saw you fully — instructed by him, O Agni, I have come.

sanskrit: vi jyoti̍ṣā bṛha̱tā bhā̍ty a̱gnir ā̱vir viśvā̍ni kṛṇute mahi̱tvā | prāde̍vīr mā̱yāḥ sa̍hate du̱revā̱ḥ śiśī̍te̱ śṛṅge̱ rakṣa̍se vi̱nikṣe̍ ||
english: Agni blazes with great light, making all things manifest by his greatness; he overcomes the godless illusions and those of ill approach; he sharpens his horns to pierce the demon.

sanskrit: u̱ta svā̱nāso̍ di̱vi ṣa̍ntv a̱gnes ti̱gmāyu̍dhā̱ rakṣa̍se̱ hanta̱vā u̍ | made̍ cid asya̱ pra ru̍janti̱ bhāmā̱ na va̍rante pari̱bādho̱ ade̍vīḥ ||
english: And may the howlers of Agni be in the sky — his sharp weapons ready to slay the demon; even in his exultation his flames burst forth, and the godless obstructions do not withstand them.

sanskrit: e̱taṁ te̱ stoma̍ṁ tuvijāta̱ vipro̱ ratha̱ṁ na dhīra̱ḥ svapā̍ atakṣam | yadīd a̍gne̱ prati̱ tvaṁ de̍va̱ haryā̱ḥ sva̍rvatīr a̱pa e̍nā jayema ||
english: This hymn of praise for you, O Tuvijāta, the inspired one, the wise craftsman, has fashioned like a chariot; if, O Agni, O god, you are pleased with it, may we win by means of it the sun-lit waters.

sanskrit: tu̱vi̱grīvo̍ vṛṣa̱bho vā̍vṛdhā̱no̍ 'śa̱trv a1̱̍ryaḥ sam a̍jāti̱ veda̍ḥ | itī̱mam a̱gnim a̱mṛtā̍ avocan ba̱rhiṣma̍te̱ mana̍ve̱ śarma̍ yaṁsad dha̱viṣma̍te̱ mana̍ve̱ śarma̍ yaṁsat ||
english: The bull of mighty neck, waxing great, the lordly one without enemies, brings wealth together. Thus the immortals have declared of this Agni: may he grant shelter to Manu who spreads the sacred grass, may he grant shelter to Manu who offers oblation.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne̱ varu̍ṇo̱ jāya̍se̱ yat tvam mi̱tro bha̍vasi̱ yat sami̍ddhaḥ | tve viśve̍ sahasas putra de̱vās tvam indro̍ dā̱śuṣe̱ martyā̍ya ||
english: You, O Agni, are born as Varuṇa when kindled; you become Mitra when blazing; in you are all the gods, O son of strength; you are Indra for the mortal who worships.

sanskrit: tvam a̍rya̱mā bha̍vasi̱ yat ka̱nīnā̱ṁ nāma̍ svadhāva̱n guhya̍m bibharṣi | a̱ñjanti̍ mi̱traṁ sudhi̍ta̱ṁ na gobhi̱r yad dampa̍tī̱ sama̍nasā kṛ̱ṇoṣi̍ ||
english: You become Aryaman when you bear the secret name of maidens, O self-nourishing one; they anoint Mitra, well-placed, as with rays of light, when you unite the married couple in one mind.

sanskrit: tava̍ śri̱ye ma̱ruto̍ marjayanta̱ rudra̱ yat te̱ jani̍ma̱ cāru̍ ci̱tram | pa̱daṁ yad viṣṇo̍r upa̱maṁ ni̱dhāyi̱ tena̍ pāsi̱ guhya̱ṁ nāma̱ gonā̍m ||
english: For your splendor the Maruts cleanse themselves, O Rudra, for your birth is beautiful and variegated; where Viṣṇu's highest step was placed, with that you protect the secret name of the cows.

sanskrit: tava̍ śri̱yā su̱dṛśo̍ deva de̱vāḥ pu̱rū dadhā̍nā a̱mṛta̍ṁ sapanta | hotā̍ram a̱gnim manu̍ṣo̱ ni ṣe̍dur daśa̱syanta̍ u̱śija̱ḥ śaṁsa̍m ā̱yoḥ ||
english: By your splendor, O god of beautiful appearance, the gods holding many things attended the immortal; the eager ones, honoring the praises of Āyu, placed Agni as Hotṛ for the son of Manu.

sanskrit: na tvad dhotā̱ pūrvo̍ agne̱ yajī̍yā̱n na kāvyai̍ḥ pa̱ro a̍sti svadhāvaḥ | vi̱śaś ca̱ yasyā̱ ati̍thi̱r bhavā̍si̱ sa ya̱jñena̍ vanavad deva̱ martā̍n ||
english: No Hotṛ earlier than you, O Agni, is more worthy of sacrifice; no self-nourishing one surpasses you in poetic wisdom; and the clans whose guest you become — that one will win mortals by his sacrifice, O god.

sanskrit: va̱yam a̍gne vanuyāma̱ tvotā̍ vasū̱yavo̍ ha̱viṣā̱ budhya̍mānāḥ | va̱yaṁ sa̍ma̱rye vi̱dathe̱ṣv ahnā̍ṁ va̱yaṁ rā̱yā sa̍hasas putra̱ martā̍n ||
english: May we, O Agni, aided by you, win, desiring wealth, awakened through the oblation; may we prevail in battle and in the contests of the days; may we, O son of strength, prevail over mortals with riches.

sanskrit: yo na̱ āgo̍ a̱bhy eno̱ bharā̱ty adhīd a̱gham a̱ghaśa̍ṁse dadhāta | ja̱hī ci̍kitvo a̱bhiśa̍stim e̱tām agne̱ yo no̍ ma̱rcaya̍ti dva̱yena̍ ||
english: He who brings sin and transgression against us — let guilt rest upon the evil-speaking one; smite, O knowing Agni, this curse — him who injures us with duplicity.

sanskrit: tvām a̱syā vyuṣi̍ deva̱ pūrve̍ dū̱taṁ kṛ̍ṇvā̱nā a̍yajanta ha̱vyaiḥ | sa̱ṁsthe yad a̍gna̱ īya̍se rayī̱ṇāṁ de̱vo martai̱r vasu̍bhir i̱dhyamā̍naḥ ||
english: The ancients at the dawning of this day sacrificed to you with oblations, making you their messenger, O god; when you go, O Agni, toward the assembly of riches, kindled by mortals with precious fuel — a god.

sanskrit: ava̍ spṛdhi pi̱tara̱ṁ yodhi̍ vi̱dvān pu̱tro yas te̍ sahasaḥ sūna ū̱he | ka̱dā ci̍kitvo a̱bhi ca̍kṣase̱ no 'gne̍ ka̱dām̐ ṛ̍ta̱cid yā̍tayāse ||
english: Protect the father, fight, O knowing son who bears you, O child of strength; when, O knowing Agni, will you look upon us? When will you, the knower of Ṛta, requite justly?

sanskrit: bhūri̱ nāma̱ vanda̍māno dadhāti pi̱tā va̍so̱ yadi̱ taj jo̱ṣayā̍se | ku̱vid de̱vasya̱ saha̍sā cakā̱naḥ su̱mnam a̱gnir va̍nate vāvṛdhā̱naḥ ||
english: He who worships acquires many names, O bright Vasu, if you delight in that; will Agni, delighting in the god's strength and waxing great, win favor?

sanskrit: tvam a̱ṅga ja̍ri̱tāra̍ṁ yaviṣṭha̱ viśvā̍ny agne duri̱tāti̍ parṣi | ste̱nā a̍dṛśran ri̱pavo̱ janā̱so 'jñā̍taketā vṛji̱nā a̍bhūvan ||
english: You indeed, O youngest Agni, carry the praiser across all difficulties; the thieves and the enemy peoples have been seen — those of unknown intent have become crooked.

sanskrit: i̱me yāmā̍sas tva̱drig a̍bhūva̱n vasa̍ve vā̱ tad id āgo̍ avāci | nāhā̱yam a̱gnir a̱bhiśa̍staye no̱ na rīṣa̍te vāvṛdhā̱naḥ parā̍ dāt ||
english: These paths have come toward you, O Vasu, or that sin has been uttered; this Agni here does not harm us for the curse, nor, waxing great, does he give us over to injury.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gne̱ vasu̍pati̱ṁ vasū̍nām a̱bhi pra ma̍nde adhva̱reṣu̍ rājan | tvayā̱ vāja̍ṁ vāja̱yanto̍ jayemā̱bhi ṣyā̍ma pṛtsu̱tīr martyā̍nām ||
english: You, O Agni, O king, lord of good things — I exhilarate you with praise at the rites; striving for the prize through you, may we win; may we overcome the battle-forces of mortals.

sanskrit: ha̱vya̱vāḻ a̱gnir a̱jara̍ḥ pi̱tā no̍ vi̱bhur vi̱bhāvā̍ su̱dṛśī̍ko a̱sme | su̱gā̱rha̱pa̱tyāḥ sam iṣo̍ didīhy asma̱drya1̱̍k sam mi̍mīhi̱ śravā̍ṁsi ||
english: Agni, the carrier of oblations, ageless, our father, all-pervading, widely shining, beautiful to see, is among us; shine brilliantly together as oblations easy to manage in the household; bring together glories directed toward us.

sanskrit: vi̱śāṁ ka̱viṁ vi̱śpati̱m mānu̍ṣīṇā̱ṁ śuci̍m pāva̱kaṁ ghṛ̱tapṛ̍ṣṭham a̱gnim | ni hotā̍raṁ viśva̱vida̍ṁ dadhidhve̱ sa de̱veṣu̍ vanate̱ vāryā̍ṇi ||
english: Set down as Hotṛ Agni — the seer of the clans, lord of the peoples of men, the pure, the purifying, bright-backed; he wins desirable things among the gods.

sanskrit: ju̱ṣasvā̍gna̱ iḻa̍yā sa̱joṣā̱ yata̍māno ra̱śmibhi̱ḥ sūrya̍sya | ju̱ṣasva̍ naḥ sa̱midha̍ṁ jātaveda̱ ā ca̍ de̱vān ha̍vi̱radyā̍ya vakṣi ||
english: Be pleased, O Agni, together with Iḷā, striving with the rays of the sun; be pleased with our fuel, O Jātavedas, and bring hither the gods to eat the oblation.

sanskrit: juṣṭo̱ damū̍nā̱ ati̍thir duro̱ṇa i̱maṁ no̍ ya̱jñam upa̍ yāhi vi̱dvān | viśvā̍ agne abhi̱yujo̍ vi̱hatyā̍ śatrūya̱tām ā bha̍rā̱ bhoja̍nāni ||
english: Welcome as household guest within the home, come hither, O knowing one, to this our sacrifice; O Agni, smiting down all who assail us, bring hither the enjoyments of those who act as enemies.

sanskrit: va̱dhena̱ dasyu̱m pra hi cā̱taya̍sva̱ vaya̍ḥ kṛṇvā̱nas ta̱nve̱3̱̍ svāyai̍ | pipa̍rṣi̱ yat sa̍hasas putra de̱vānt so a̍gne pāhi nṛtama̱ vāje̍ a̱smān ||
english: Drive the dasyu away with your weapon, gaining strength for your own body; inasmuch as you carry the gods across, O son of strength, O Agni, most manly one, protect us in the contest.

sanskrit: va̱yaṁ te̍ agna u̱kthair vi̍dhema va̱yaṁ ha̱vyaiḥ pā̍vaka bhadraśoce | a̱sme ra̱yiṁ vi̱śvavā̍ra̱ṁ sam i̍nvā̱sme viśvā̍ni̱ dravi̍ṇāni dhehi ||
english: May we serve you, O Agni, with recitations; may we serve you with oblations, O purifier, O auspiciously blazing one; send together for us riches containing all good things; place all treasures in us.

sanskrit: a̱smāka̍m agne adhva̱raṁ ju̍ṣasva̱ saha̍saḥ sūno triṣadhastha ha̱vyam | va̱yaṁ de̱veṣu̍ su̱kṛta̍ḥ syāma̱ śarma̍ṇā nas tri̱varū̍thena pāhi ||
english: Be pleased, O Agni, with our rite, O son of strength, O dweller in three stations, with our oblation; may we be well-doers among the gods; protect us with your triple shelter.

sanskrit: viśvā̍ni no du̱rgahā̍ jātaveda̱ḥ sindhu̱ṁ na nā̱vā du̍ri̱tāti̍ parṣi | agne̍ atri̱van nama̍sā gṛṇā̱no̱3̱̍ 'smāka̍m bodhy avi̱tā ta̱nūnā̍m ||
english: O Jātavedas, carry us across all hard passages and all evils as a boat crosses a river; O Agni, praised with reverence like Atri, be the protector of our bodies.

sanskrit: yas tvā̍ hṛ̱dā kī̱riṇā̱ manya̍mā̱no 'ma̍rtya̱m martyo̱ joha̍vīmi | jāta̍vedo̱ yaśo̍ a̱smāsu̍ dhehi pra̱jābhi̍r agne amṛta̱tvam a̍śyām ||
english: I, a mortal, invoking you repeatedly, contemplating you the immortal with a praising heart — O Jātavedas, place fame in us; may I, O Agni, attain immortality through offspring.

sanskrit: yasmai̱ tvaṁ su̱kṛte̍ jātaveda u lo̱kam a̍gne kṛ̱ṇava̍ḥ syo̱nam | a̱śvina̱ṁ sa pu̱triṇa̍ṁ vī̱rava̍nta̱ṁ goma̍ntaṁ ra̱yiṁ na̍śate sva̱sti ||
english: For whom you make an easy world, O Jātavedas, O Agni, for the well-doer — that one attains with good fortune wealth rich in horses, in sons, in heroes, and in cattle.

sanskrit: susa̍middhāya śo̱ciṣe̍ ghṛ̱taṁ tī̱vraṁ ju̍hotana | a̱gnaye̍ jā̱tave̍dase ||
english: Pour strong ghee for the blazing one well kindled — for Agni Jātavedas.

sanskrit: narā̱śaṁsa̍ḥ suṣūdatī̱maṁ ya̱jñam adā̍bhyaḥ | ka̱vir hi madhu̍hastyaḥ ||
english: Narāśaṁsa, the undeceivable, shall speed this sacrifice along — for he is the honey-handed seer.

sanskrit: ī̱ḻi̱to a̍gna̱ ā va̱hendra̍ṁ ci̱tram i̱ha pri̱yam | su̱khai rathe̍bhir ū̱taye̍ ||
english: Being invoked, O Agni, bring hither brilliant Indra, the dear one, on his pleasant chariots for our aid.

sanskrit: ūrṇa̍mradā̱ vi pra̍thasvā̱bhy a1̱̍rkā a̍nūṣata | bhavā̍ naḥ śubhra sā̱taye̍ ||
english: O Ūrṇamradā, spread widely; the praises have sung in response — be present for our winning, O bright one.

sanskrit: devī̍r dvāro̱ vi śra̍yadhvaṁ suprāya̱ṇā na̍ ū̱taye̍ | pra-pra̍ ya̱jñam pṛ̍ṇītana ||
english: Open wide, O divine doors, easy to pass through, for our aid; fulfill the sacrifice fully.

sanskrit: su̱pratī̍ke vayo̱vṛdhā̍ ya̱hvī ṛ̱tasya̍ mā̱tarā̍ | do̱ṣām u̱ṣāsa̍m īmahe ||
english: Of beautiful appearance, growing in strength, the two great mothers of Ṛta — we summon Night and Dawn.

sanskrit: vāta̍sya̱ patma̍nn īḻi̱tā daivyā̱ hotā̍rā̱ manu̍ṣaḥ | i̱maṁ no̍ ya̱jñam ā ga̍tam ||
english: On the path of the wind, the two divine Hotṛs invoked by the son of Manu — come to this our sacrifice.

sanskrit: iḻā̱ sara̍svatī ma̱hī ti̱sro de̱vīr ma̍yo̱bhuva̍ḥ | ba̱rhiḥ sī̍dantv a̱sridha̍ḥ ||
english: Iḷā, Sarasvatī, and great Mahī — three goddesses born of bliss — may they, unfailing, take their seat on the sacred grass.

sanskrit: śi̱vas tva̍ṣṭar i̱hā ga̍hi vi̱bhuḥ poṣa̍ u̱ta tmanā̍ | ya̱jñe-ya̍jñe na̱ ud a̍va ||
english: O auspicious Tvaṣṭar, come hither — all-pervading nourishment in person; support us at every sacrifice.

sanskrit: yatra̱ vettha̍ vanaspate de̱vānā̱ṁ guhyā̱ nāmā̍ni | tatra̍ ha̱vyāni̍ gāmaya ||
english: O Lord of the Forest, where you know the secret names of the gods, thither guide our oblations.

sanskrit: svāhā̱gnaye̱ varu̍ṇāya̱ svāhendrā̍ya ma̱rudbhya̍ḥ | svāhā̍ de̱vebhyo̍ ha̱viḥ ||
english: Svāhā — the oblation to Agni and Varuṇa; svāhā — to Indra and the Maruts; svāhā — the oblation to all the gods.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ tam ma̍nye̱ yo vasu̱r asta̱ṁ yaṁ yanti̍ dhe̱nava̍ḥ | asta̱m arva̍nta ā̱śavo 'sta̱ṁ nityā̍so vā̱jina̱ iṣa̍ṁ sto̱tṛbhya̱ ā bha̍ra ||
english: That Agni I consider the good one, toward whom the milch-cows go home, toward whom the swift coursers go home, toward whom the constant prize-winners go home — bring refreshment to the praisers.

sanskrit: so a̱gnir yo vasu̍r gṛ̱ṇe saṁ yam ā̱yanti̍ dhe̱nava̍ḥ | sam arva̍nto raghu̱druva̱ḥ saṁ su̍jā̱tāsa̍ḥ sū̱raya̱ iṣa̍ṁ sto̱tṛbhya̱ ā bha̍ra ||
english: That Agni whom I praise is the good one, toward whom the milch-cows come together, toward whom the swift-running coursers come together, toward whom the nobly-born lords come together — bring refreshment to the praisers.

sanskrit: a̱gnir hi vā̱jina̍ṁ vi̱śe dadā̍ti vi̱śvaca̍rṣaṇiḥ | a̱gnī rā̱ye svā̱bhuva̱ṁ sa prī̱to yā̍ti̱ vārya̱m iṣa̍ṁ sto̱tṛbhya̱ ā bha̍ra ||
english: For Agni, beholder of all, gives the prize to the clan; Agni, being pleased, goes to wealth self-arisen, to the desired — bring refreshment to the praisers.

sanskrit: ā te̍ agna idhīmahi dyu̱manta̍ṁ devā̱jara̍m | yad dha̱ syā te̱ panī̍yasī sa̱mid dī̱daya̍ti̱ dyavīṣa̍ṁ sto̱tṛbhya̱ ā bha̍ra ||
english: We kindle you, O Agni, brilliant and ageless like a god; when that most admirable fuel of yours blazes day by day — bring refreshment to the praisers.

sanskrit: ā te̍ agna ṛ̱cā ha̱viḥ śukra̍sya śociṣas pate | suśca̍ndra̱ dasma̱ viśpa̍te̱ havya̍vā̱ṭ tubhya̍ṁ hūyata̱ iṣa̍ṁ sto̱tṛbhya̱ ā bha̍ra ||
english: With the sacred verse, O Agni, the oblation of the pure one, lord of the flame — O fair-shining, wondrous lord of clans, to you as carrier of oblations it is poured — bring refreshment to the praisers.

sanskrit: pro tye a̱gnayo̱ 'gniṣu̱ viśva̍m puṣyanti̱ vārya̍m | te hi̍nvire̱ ta i̍nvire̱ ta i̍ṣaṇyanty ānu̱ṣag iṣa̍ṁ sto̱tṛbhya̱ ā bha̍ra ||
english: Those fires in the fires nourish all that is desirable; they have propelled, they have set in motion, they impel continuously — bring refreshment to the praisers.

sanskrit: tava̱ tye a̍gne a̱rcayo̱ mahi̍ vrādhanta vā̱jina̍ḥ | ye patva̍bhiḥ śa̱phānā̍ṁ vra̱jā bhu̱ranta̱ gonā̱m iṣa̍ṁ sto̱tṛbhya̱ ā bha̍ra ||
english: Those prize-winning flames of yours, O Agni, have grown greatly; they who with their flight have filled the cow-pens with the hooves' pounding — bring refreshment to the praisers.

sanskrit: navā̍ no agna̱ ā bha̍ra sto̱tṛbhya̍ḥ sukṣi̱tīr iṣa̍ḥ | te syā̍ma̱ ya ā̍nṛ̱cus tvādū̍tāso̱ dame̍-dama̱ iṣa̍ṁ sto̱tṛbhya̱ ā bha̍ra ||
english: Bring new, fresh refreshments for the praisers with good dwelling-places, O Agni; may we be those who have praised you, your messengers house by house — bring refreshment to the praisers.

sanskrit: u̱bhe su̍ścandra sa̱rpiṣo̱ darvī̍ śrīṇīṣa ā̱sani̍ | u̱to na̱ ut pu̍pūryā u̱ktheṣu̍ śavasas pata̱ iṣa̍ṁ sto̱tṛbhya̱ ā bha̍ra ||
english: O fair-shining one, anoint both ladles of ghee with your mouth; and fill us full through our recitations, O lord of strength — bring refreshment to the praisers.

sanskrit: e̱vām̐ a̱gnim a̍juryamur gī̱rbhir ya̱jñebhi̍r ānu̱ṣak | dadha̍d a̱sme su̱vīrya̍m u̱ta tyad ā̱śvaśvya̱m iṣa̍ṁ sto̱tṛbhya̱ ā bha̍ra ||
english: Thus they have worshipped Agni without aging, with songs and sacrifices continuously; placing in us good heroic strength and also that wealth in swift horses — bring refreshment to the praisers.

sanskrit: sakhā̍ya̱ḥ saṁ va̍ḥ sa̱myañca̱m iṣa̱ṁ stoma̍ṁ cā̱gnaye̍ | varṣi̍ṣṭhāya kṣitī̱nām ū̱rjo naptre̱ saha̍svate ||
english: O friends, bring together for Agni your convergent refreshment and praise — for the mightiest of the settlements, the grandson of strength, the vigorous.

sanskrit: kutrā̍ ci̱d yasya̱ samṛ̍tau ra̱ṇvā naro̍ nṛ̱ṣada̍ne | arha̍ntaś ci̱d yam i̍ndha̱te sa̍ṁja̱naya̍nti ja̱ntava̍ḥ ||
english: He at whose meeting-place the joyful men sit in the seat of heroes — even those who are deserving kindle him, and living beings generate him.

sanskrit: saṁ yad i̱ṣo vanā̍mahe̱ saṁ ha̱vyā mānu̍ṣāṇām | u̱ta dyu̱mnasya̱ śava̍sa ṛ̱tasya̍ ra̱śmim ā da̍de ||
english: When we seek together the refreshments, together the oblations of men, I grasp also the cord of splendor and of strength, of Ṛta.

sanskrit: sa smā̍ kṛṇoti ke̱tum ā nakta̍ṁ cid dū̱ra ā sa̱te | pā̱va̱ko yad vana̱spatī̱n pra smā̍ mi̱nāty a̱jara̍ḥ ||
english: He makes his beacon even at night for one sitting far away; when the purifier, the ageless one, he destroys the forest trees.

sanskrit: ava̍ sma̱ yasya̱ veṣa̍ṇe̱ sveda̍m pa̱thiṣu̱ juhva̍ti | a̱bhīm aha̱ svaje̍nya̱m bhūmā̍ pṛ̱ṣṭheva̍ ruruhuḥ ||
english: In his attack they pour sweat onto the paths; indeed the multitude has climbed up over him like the back of the earth, his own kinsman.

sanskrit: yam martya̍ḥ puru̱spṛha̍ṁ vi̱dad viśva̍sya̱ dhāya̍se | pra svāda̍nam pitū̱nām asta̍tātiṁ cid ā̱yave̍ ||
english: Whomever a mortal finds, widely desired, to sustain all things — he sets before Āyu the tasting of nourishments and even what has not been spread out.

sanskrit: sa hi ṣmā̱ dhanvākṣi̍ta̱ṁ dātā̱ na dāty ā pa̱śuḥ | hiri̍śmaśru̱ḥ śuci̍dann ṛ̱bhur ani̍bhṛṣṭataviṣiḥ ||
english: For he indeed was ever the giver of what grows on the desert plain, as a beast gives; of golden beard, white-toothed, skillful, of undiminished might.

sanskrit: śuci̍ḥ ṣma̱ yasmā̍ atri̱vat pra svadhi̍tīva̱ rīya̍te | su̱ṣūr a̍sūta mā̱tā krā̱ṇā yad ā̍na̱śe bhaga̍m ||
english: The pure one ever flows forth for him like Atri, like an axe going forward; the good mother brought him forth, the active one when she attained good fortune.

sanskrit: ā yas te̍ sarpirāsu̱te 'gne̱ śam asti̱ dhāya̍se | aiṣu̍ dyu̱mnam u̱ta śrava̱ ā ci̱ttam martye̍ṣu dhāḥ ||
english: He for whom ghee is poured out, O Agni, it is bliss for his nourishing; in these ones place splendor and also renown, place insight among mortals.

sanskrit: iti̍ cin ma̱nyum a̱dhrija̱s tvādā̍ta̱m ā pa̱śuṁ da̍de | ād a̍gne̱ apṛ̍ṇa̱to 'tri̍ḥ sāsahyā̱d dasyū̍n i̱ṣaḥ sā̍sahyā̱n nṝn ||
english: Even so the unrestrained one, accepting his anger, receives from you the gift of cattle; thereupon, O Agni, Atri, having sated the ungiven, has overcome the dasyus in contest, has overcome the men.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gna ṛtā̱yava̱ḥ sam ī̍dhire pra̱tnam pra̱tnāsa̍ ū̱taye̍ sahaskṛta | pu̱ru̱śca̱ndraṁ ya̍ja̱taṁ vi̱śvadhā̍yasa̱ṁ damū̍nasaṁ gṛ̱hapa̍ti̱ṁ vare̍ṇyam ||
english: Those who follow Ṛta have kindled you, the ancient, the ancient ones for aid, O strength-made; the much-shining, the adorable, all-sustaining, of the household, the lord of the home, the excellent.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gne̱ ati̍thim pū̱rvyaṁ viśa̍ḥ śo̱ciṣke̍śaṁ gṛ̱hapa̍ti̱ṁ ni ṣe̍dire | bṛ̱hatke̍tum puru̱rūpa̍ṁ dhana̱spṛta̍ṁ su̱śarmā̍ṇa̱ṁ svava̍saṁ jara̱dviṣa̍m ||
english: The clans have set you down, O Agni, the ancient guest, flame-haired lord of the home — of lofty banner, of many forms, touching wealth, of good shelter, of good help, hating old age.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gne̱ mānu̍ṣīr īḻate̱ viśo̍ hotrā̱vida̱ṁ vivi̍ciṁ ratna̱dhāta̍mam | guhā̱ santa̍ṁ subhaga vi̱śvada̍rśataṁ tuviṣva̱ṇasa̍ṁ su̱yaja̍ṁ ghṛta̱śriya̍m ||
english: The human clans invoke you, O Agni, knowing the Hotṛ's lore, the discerning, the greatest bestower of gems; dwelling in the hidden place, O fortunate one, visible to all, of mighty sound, easy to sacrifice to, of ghee-splendor.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gne dharṇa̱siṁ vi̱śvadhā̍ va̱yaṁ gī̱rbhir gṛ̱ṇanto̱ nama̱sopa̍ sedima | sa no̍ juṣasva samidhā̱no a̍ṅgiro de̱vo marta̍sya ya̱śasā̍ sudī̱tibhi̍ḥ ||
english: We have approached you, O Agni, firm and all-sustaining, praising you with songs and with reverence; be pleased with us when kindled, O Aṅgiras, a god with the splendor and fair shining of mortals.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne puru̱rūpo̍ vi̱śe-vi̍śe̱ vayo̍ dadhāsi pra̱tnathā̍ puruṣṭuta | pu̱rūṇy annā̱ saha̍sā̱ vi rā̍jasi̱ tviṣi̱ḥ sā te̍ titviṣā̱ṇasya̱ nādhṛṣe̍ ||
english: You, O Agni, of many forms, place vigor in clan after clan in the ancient way, O much-praised one; you reign by might over many foods; that fierceness of yours, when you rage, is not to be defied.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gne samidhā̱naṁ ya̍viṣṭhya de̱vā dū̱taṁ ca̍krire havya̱vāha̍nam | u̱ru̱jraya̍saṁ ghṛ̱tayo̍ni̱m āhu̍taṁ tve̱ṣaṁ cakṣu̍r dadhire coda̱yanma̍ti ||
english: You, O youngest Agni, being kindled, the gods have made the messenger and carrier of oblations; of wide course, ghee-born, fed with offerings — they have placed your fierce eye that impels the mind.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gne pra̱diva̱ āhu̍taṁ ghṛ̱taiḥ su̍mnā̱yava̍ḥ suṣa̱midhā̱ sam ī̍dhire | sa vā̍vṛdhā̱na oṣa̍dhībhir ukṣi̱to̱3̱̍ 'bhi jrayā̍ṁsi̱ pārthi̍vā̱ vi ti̍ṣṭhase ||
english: Those seeking your goodwill have from of old kindled you fed with ghees, with good fuel well alight; you waxing great, sprinkled with herbs, spread yourself over the terrestrial regions.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gne ha̱viṣma̍nto de̱vam martā̍sa īḻate | manye̍ tvā jā̱tave̍dasa̱ṁ sa ha̱vyā va̍kṣy ānu̱ṣak ||
english: Those who possess oblations, being mortals, invoke you as a god, O Agni; I consider you Jātavedas — you carry the offerings continuously.

sanskrit: a̱gnir hotā̱ dāsva̍ta̱ḥ kṣaya̍sya vṛ̱ktaba̍rhiṣaḥ | saṁ ya̱jñāsa̱ś cara̍nti̱ yaṁ saṁ vājā̍saḥ śrava̱syava̍ḥ ||
english: Agni is the Hotṛ of the dwelling of the generous one who has strewn the sacred grass; sacrifices go together toward him, and prize-seekers seeking renown.

sanskrit: u̱ta sma̱ yaṁ śiśu̍ṁ yathā̱ nava̱ṁ jani̍ṣṭā̱raṇī̍ | dha̱rtāra̱m mānu̍ṣīṇāṁ vi̱śām a̱gniṁ sva̍dhva̱ram ||
english: And him whom the fire-drill has newly generated as an infant — Agni, the upholder of the human clans and settlements, performing the good rite.

sanskrit: u̱ta sma̍ durgṛbhīyase pu̱tro na hvā̱ryāṇā̍m | pu̱rū yo dagdhāsi̱ vanāgne̍ pa̱śur na yava̍se ||
english: And you are seized with difficulty like the son of those who are to be invoked; you who have burned many forests, O Agni, like a beast in pasture.

sanskrit: adha̍ sma̱ yasyā̱rcaya̍ḥ sa̱myak sa̱ṁyanti̍ dhū̱mina̍ḥ | yad ī̱m aha̍ tri̱to di̱vy upa̱ dhmāte̍va̱ dhama̍ti̱ śiśī̍te dhmā̱tarī̍ yathā ||
english: And he whose smoky flames come together rightly — when Trita in the sky blows upon him as a bellows-blower blows, he sharpens like a whetstone.

sanskrit: tavā̱ham a̍gna ū̱tibhi̍r mi̱trasya̍ ca̱ praśa̍stibhiḥ | dve̱ṣo̱yuto̱ na du̍ri̱tā tu̱ryāma̱ martyā̍nām ||
english: Through your aids, O Agni, and through the praises of Mitra, may we overcome, joined together against hate, the evils and the enemies of mortals.

sanskrit: taṁ no̍ agne a̱bhī naro̍ ra̱yiṁ sa̍hasva̱ ā bha̍ra | sa kṣe̍paya̱t sa po̍ṣaya̱d bhuva̱d vāja̍sya sā̱taya̍ u̱taidhi̍ pṛ̱tsu no̍ vṛ̱dhe ||
english: Him, O Agni, as our hero, press forward and bring us wealth; may he fling it, may he nourish it, may he be for the winning of the prize; and be present for our growth in battles.

sanskrit: agna̱ oji̍ṣṭha̱m ā bha̍ra dyu̱mnam a̱smabhya̍m adhrigo | pra no̍ rā̱yā parī̍ṇasā̱ ratsi̱ vājā̍ya̱ panthā̍m ||
english: O Agni, bring us the most vigorous splendor, O unrestrained one; fill us with encircling riches; reveal the path to the prize.

sanskrit: tvaṁ no̍ agne adbhuta̱ kratvā̱ dakṣa̍sya ma̱ṁhanā̍ | tve a̍su̱rya1̱̍m āru̍hat krā̱ṇā mi̱tro na ya̱jñiya̍ḥ ||
english: You, O Agni, O wondrous one, with the generosity of wisdom and discernment — in you the lordly power has mounted, the active one, like Mitra worthy of worship.

sanskrit: tvaṁ no̍ agna eṣā̱ṁ gaya̍m pu̱ṣṭiṁ ca̍ vardhaya | ye stome̍bhi̱ḥ pra sū̱rayo̱ naro̍ ma̱ghāny ā̍na̱śuḥ ||
english: You, O Agni, augment the home and prosperity of these — the heroes, the lords who have attained riches through their hymns of praise.

sanskrit: ye a̍gne candra te̱ gira̍ḥ śu̱mbhanty aśva̍rādhasaḥ | śuṣme̍bhiḥ śu̱ṣmiṇo̱ naro̍ di̱vaś ci̱d yeṣā̍m bṛ̱hat su̍kī̱rtir bodha̍ti̱ tmanā̍ ||
english: Those, O Agni, whose shining praises adorn you, the wealthy — the vigorous heroes through their vigors, whose great and fair renown blazes from heaven of its own accord.

sanskrit: tava̱ tye a̍gne a̱rcayo̱ bhrāja̍nto yanti dhṛṣṇu̱yā | pari̍jmāno̱ na vi̱dyuta̍ḥ svā̱no ratho̱ na vā̍ja̱yuḥ ||
english: Those flames of yours, O Agni, blazing, go forth boldly; like lightning going around, sounding like a chariot seeking the prize.

sanskrit: nū no̍ agna ū̱taye̍ sa̱bādha̍saś ca rā̱taye̍ | a̱smākā̍saś ca sū̱rayo̱ viśvā̱ āśā̍s tarī̱ṣaṇi̍ ||
english: Now, O Agni, for our aid and for the giving, even when hemmed in — may our lords cross all the regions.

sanskrit: tvaṁ no̍ agne aṅgiraḥ stu̱taḥ stavā̍na̱ ā bha̍ra | hota̍r vibhvā̱saha̍ṁ ra̱yiṁ sto̱tṛbhya̱ḥ stava̍se ca na u̱taidhi̍ pṛ̱tsu no̍ vṛ̱dhe ||
english: You, O Agni Aṅgiras, praised and praiseworthy, bring us wealth, all-conquering, O Hotṛ, for the praisers and for our own praise; and be present for our growth in battles.

sanskrit: jana̍sya go̱pā a̍janiṣṭa̱ jāgṛ̍vir a̱gniḥ su̱dakṣa̍ḥ suvi̱tāya̱ navya̍se | ghṛ̱tapra̍tīko bṛha̱tā di̍vi̱spṛśā̍ dyu̱mad vi bhā̍ti bhara̱tebhya̱ḥ śuci̍ḥ ||
english: Agni, the watchful guardian of the people, has been born, wise and skilled, for a newer good fortune; facing forward with ghee, touching the sky with his great flame, he shines brilliantly and purely for the Bharatas.

sanskrit: ya̱jñasya̍ ke̱tum pra̍tha̱mam pu̱rohi̍tam a̱gniṁ nara̍s triṣadha̱sthe sam ī̍dhire | indre̍ṇa de̱vaiḥ sa̱ratha̱ṁ sa ba̱rhiṣi̱ sīda̱n ni hotā̍ ya̱jathā̍ya su̱kratu̍ḥ ||
english: The heroes have kindled Agni, the banner of the sacrifice, the foremost priest placed in front, in his triple seat; he who sits on the sacred grass on the same chariot with Indra and the gods — the Hotṛ of good will, sitting down to sacrifice.

sanskrit: asa̍mmṛṣṭo jāyase mā̱troḥ śuci̍r ma̱ndraḥ ka̱vir ud a̍tiṣṭho vi̱vasva̍taḥ | ghṛ̱tena̍ tvāvardhayann agna āhuta dhū̱mas te̍ ke̱tur a̍bhavad di̱vi śri̱taḥ ||
english: You are born unsmeared, pure from your two mothers, the roaring seer; you have risen from Vivasvat; they have increased you, O Agni, with ghee, O you fed with oblations; your smoke has become a banner resting in the sky.

sanskrit: a̱gnir no̍ ya̱jñam upa̍ vetu sādhu̱yāgniṁ naro̱ vi bha̍rante gṛ̱he-gṛ̍he | a̱gnir dū̱to a̍bhavad dhavya̱vāha̍no̱ 'gniṁ vṛ̍ṇā̱nā vṛ̍ṇate ka̱vikra̍tum ||
english: May Agni come rightly to our sacrifice; the heroes spread Agni about in house after house; Agni has become the messenger and the carrier of oblations; choosing Agni, they choose one whose will is that of a seer.

sanskrit: tubhye̱dam a̍gne̱ madhu̍mattama̱ṁ vaca̱s tubhya̍m manī̱ṣā i̱yam a̍stu̱ śaṁ hṛ̱de | tvāṁ gira̱ḥ sindhu̍m ivā̱vanī̍r ma̱hīr ā pṛ̍ṇanti̱ śava̍sā va̱rdhaya̍nti ca ||
english: For you, O Agni, is this most honey-sweet word; for you may this vision be bliss to the heart; great rivers like the Sindhu fill you with songs and increase you with strength.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gne̱ aṅgi̍raso̱ guhā̍ hi̱tam anv a̍vindañ chiśriyā̱ṇaṁ vane̍-vane | sa jā̍yase ma̱thyamā̍na̱ḥ saho̍ ma̱hat tvām ā̍hu̱ḥ saha̍sas pu̱tram a̍ṅgiraḥ ||
english: The Aṅgirasas found you hidden, dwelling in forest after forest; you are born by churning with great might; they call you the son of strength, O Aṅgiras.

sanskrit: prāgnaye̍ bṛha̱te ya̱jñiyā̍ya ṛ̱tasya̱ vṛṣṇe̱ asu̍rāya̱ manma̍ | ghṛ̱taṁ na ya̱jña ā̱sye̱3̱̍ supū̍ta̱ṁ gira̍m bhare vṛṣa̱bhāya̍ pratī̱cīm ||
english: Forth to Agni the great, the adorable, the bull of Ṛta, the lord of might, I bring the thought; like well-purified ghee in the mouth of the sacrifice, I bring a song facing toward the bull.

sanskrit: ṛ̱taṁ ci̍kitva ṛ̱tam ic ci̍kiddhy ṛ̱tasya̱ dhārā̱ anu̍ tṛndhi pū̱rvīḥ | nāhaṁ yā̱tuṁ saha̍sā̱ na dva̱yena̍ ṛ̱taṁ sa̍pāmy aru̱ṣasya̱ vṛṣṇa̍ḥ ||
english: Knowing Ṛta, do attend to Ṛta; pierce through the many currents of Ṛta; not by sorcery, not by duplicity do I serve the Ṛta of the ruddy bull.

sanskrit: kayā̍ no agna ṛ̱taya̍nn ṛ̱tena̱ bhuvo̱ nave̍dā u̱catha̍sya̱ navya̍ḥ | vedā̍ me de̱va ṛ̍tu̱pā ṛ̍tū̱nāṁ nāham pati̍ṁ sani̱tur a̱sya rā̱yaḥ ||
english: Going rightly by Ṛta, in what way, O Agni, have you become the newest knower of our recitation? O god, guard of the seasons, you know the seasons — I am not the lord of this wealth of the bestower.

sanskrit: ke te̍ agne ri̱pave̱ bandha̍nāsa̱ḥ ke pā̱yava̍ḥ saniṣanta dyu̱manta̍ḥ | ke dhā̱sim a̍gne̱ anṛ̍tasya pānti̱ ka āsa̍to̱ vaca̍saḥ santi go̱pāḥ ||
english: Who are your bonds for the deceiver, O Agni? Who are the brilliant guards that shall prevail? Who, O Agni, protect the foundation against falsehood? Who are the guardians of false speech?

sanskrit: sakhā̍yas te̱ viṣu̍ṇā agna e̱te śi̱vāsa̱ḥ santo̱ aśi̍vā abhūvan | adhū̍rṣata sva̱yam e̱te vaco̍bhir ṛjūya̱te vṛ̍ji̱nāni̍ bru̱vanta̍ḥ ||
english: These divergent companions of yours, O Agni, though appearing auspicious, have become inauspicious; they have harmed themselves through their own words, speaking crooked things to one who goes straight.

sanskrit: yas te̍ agne̱ nama̍sā ya̱jñam īṭṭa̍ ṛ̱taṁ sa pā̍ty aru̱ṣasya̱ vṛṣṇa̍ḥ | tasya̱ kṣaya̍ḥ pṛ̱thur ā sā̱dhur e̍tu pra̱sarsrā̍ṇasya̱ nahu̍ṣasya̱ śeṣa̍ḥ ||
english: He who begs sacrifice from you, O Agni, with reverence — he protects the Ṛta of the ruddy bull; may the wide and good domain of that one come forward, and the remainder of the flowing, surging Nahuṣa.

sanskrit: arca̍ntas tvā havāma̱he 'rca̍nta̱ḥ sam i̍dhīmahi | agne̱ arca̍nta ū̱taye̍ ||
english: Praising, we invoke you; praising, we kindle you; O Agni, praising, for your aid.

sanskrit: a̱gneḥ stoma̍m manāmahe si̱dhram a̱dya di̍vi̱spṛśa̍ḥ | de̱vasya̍ draviṇa̱syava̍ḥ ||
english: We have in mind the praise of Agni who goes straight to success today, touching the sky, the god who desires treasures.

sanskrit: a̱gnir ju̍ṣata no̱ giro̱ hotā̱ yo mānu̍ṣe̱ṣv ā | sa ya̍kṣa̱d daivya̱ṁ jana̍m ||
english: May Agni, the Hotṛ who is established among humans, take pleasure in our songs; may he sacrifice to the divine folk.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne sa̱prathā̍ asi̱ juṣṭo̱ hotā̱ vare̍ṇyaḥ | tvayā̍ ya̱jñaṁ vi ta̍nvate ||
english: You, O Agni, are widely extending, the welcome Hotṛ, the excellent one; through you they spread out the sacrifice.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gne vāja̱sāta̍ma̱ṁ viprā̍ vardhanti̱ suṣṭu̍tam | sa no̍ rāsva su̱vīrya̍m ||
english: You, O Agni, most gainful of prizes, the inspired ones increase, well praised; grant us good heroic power.

sanskrit: agne̍ ne̱mir a̱rām̐ i̍va de̱vām̐s tvam pa̍ri̱bhūr a̍si | ā rādha̍ś ci̱tram ṛ̍ñjase ||
english: O Agni, like the rim the spokes, you encompass the gods; you stretch toward the variegated reward.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ stome̍na bodhaya samidhā̱no ama̍rtyam | ha̱vyā de̱veṣu̍ no dadhat ||
english: Awaken Agni the immortal with the hymn when kindled; may he place our oblations among the gods.

sanskrit: tam a̍dhva̱reṣv ī̍ḻate de̱vam martā̱ ama̍rtyam | yaji̍ṣṭha̱m mānu̍ṣe̱ jane̍ ||
english: Him, the god and the immortal, the most worthy of sacrifice among human folk, the mortals invoke at the rites.

sanskrit: taṁ hi śaśva̍nta̱ ī̍ḻate sru̱cā de̱vaṁ ghṛ̍ta̱ścutā̍ | a̱gniṁ ha̱vyāya̱ voḻha̍ve ||
english: Him the constant ones ever invoke with the ladle dripping ghee — Agni, to carry the oblations.

sanskrit: a̱gnir jā̱to a̍rocata̱ ghnan dasyū̱ñ jyoti̍ṣā̱ tama̍ḥ | avi̍nda̱d gā a̱paḥ sva̍ḥ ||
english: Agni, being born, shone forth, smiting the dasyus, dispelling darkness with his light; he found the cows, the waters, and the sun.

sanskrit: a̱gnim ī̱ḻenya̍ṁ ka̱viṁ ghṛ̱tapṛ̍ṣṭhaṁ saparyata | vetu̍ me śṛ̱ṇava̱d dhava̍m ||
english: Honor Agni the worthy of invocation, the seer of bright back; may he come and hear my call.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ ghṛ̱tena̍ vāvṛdhu̱ḥ stome̍bhir vi̱śvaca̍rṣaṇim | svā̱dhībhi̍r vaca̱syubhi̍ḥ ||
english: They have increased Agni, beholder of all, with ghee, with hymns, with well-inspired and eloquent words.

sanskrit: pra ve̱dhase̍ ka̱vaye̱ vedyā̍ya̱ gira̍m bhare ya̱śase̍ pū̱rvyāya̍ | ghṛ̱tapra̍satto̱ asu̍raḥ su̱śevo̍ rā̱yo dha̱rtā dha̱ruṇo̱ vasvo̍ a̱gniḥ ||
english: I bring a song to the wise seer, the knowledgeable, the glorious, the ancient; Agni, greased with ghee, the lord, the auspicious, the holder of wealth, the foundation of riches.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tena̍ ṛ̱taṁ dha̱ruṇa̍ṁ dhārayanta ya̱jñasya̍ śā̱ke pa̍ra̱me vyo̍man | di̱vo dharma̍n dha̱ruṇe̍ se̱duṣo̱ nṝñ jā̱tair ajā̍tām̐ a̱bhi ye na̍na̱kṣuḥ ||
english: Holding fast Ṛta, the foundation, with Ṛta, in the highest power of the sacrifice, in the vault of heaven — those who have attained the foundation of the cosmic law in heaven, those who have reached mortals — both born and yet unborn.

sanskrit: a̱ṅho̱yuva̍s ta̱nva̍s tanvate̱ vi vayo̍ ma̱had du̱ṣṭara̍m pū̱rvyāya̍ | sa sa̱ṁvato̱ nava̍jātas tuturyāt si̱ṅhaṁ na kru̱ddham a̱bhita̱ḥ pari̍ ṣṭhuḥ ||
english: Those who are released from distress spread out great, hard-to-cross vigor for the ancient one; the newly-born has crossed over the year, they have stood around him from all sides like an angry lion.

sanskrit: mā̱teva̱ yad bhara̍se paprathā̱no jana̍ṁ-jana̱ṁ dhāya̍se̱ cakṣa̍se ca | vayo̍-vayo jarase̱ yad dadhā̍na̱ḥ pari̱ tmanā̱ viṣu̍rūpo jigāsi ||
english: When you spread yourself wide, carrying like a mother, nourishing and watching over people after people; placing vigor in each successive stage, you go about of yourself, of diverse forms.

sanskrit: vājo̱ nu te̱ śava̍sas pā̱tv anta̍m u̱ruṁ dogha̍ṁ dha̱ruṇa̍ṁ deva rā̱yaḥ | pa̱daṁ na tā̱yur guhā̱ dadhā̍no ma̱ho rā̱ye ci̱taya̱nn atri̍m aspaḥ ||
english: May the prize guard the far end of your strength, the wide yielding foundation of wealth, O god; like a thief placing his foot in hiding, illuminating for great wealth, you have touched Atri.

sanskrit: bṛ̱had vayo̱ hi bhā̱nave 'rcā̍ de̱vāyā̱gnaye̍ | yam mi̱traṁ na praśa̍stibhi̱r martā̍so dadhi̱re pu̱raḥ ||
english: Sing forth great vigor for the blazing one, for the god Agni; whom, like Mitra, the mortals have placed in front with their praises.

sanskrit: sa hi dyubhi̱r janā̍nā̱ṁ hotā̱ dakṣa̍sya bā̱hvoḥ | vi ha̱vyam a̱gnir ā̍nu̱ṣag bhago̱ na vāra̍m ṛṇvati ||
english: For he is the Hotṛ of the peoples by day, in the arms of discernment; Agni, like Bhaga, distributes the oblation and impels the desired thing continuously.

sanskrit: a̱sya stome̍ ma̱ghona̍ḥ sa̱khye vṛ̱ddhaśo̍ciṣaḥ | viśvā̱ yasmi̍n tuvi̱ṣvaṇi̱ sam a̱rye śuṣma̍m āda̱dhuḥ ||
english: In the praise of this generous one, the friend of the one whose flame has grown — in him in the greatly resounding battle they have placed all vigor.

sanskrit: adhā̱ hy a̍gna eṣāṁ su̱vīrya̍sya ma̱ṁhanā̍ | tam id ya̱hvaṁ na roda̍sī̱ pari̱ śravo̍ babhūvatuḥ ||
english: Thus truly, O Agni, by the generosity of their good heroic power — around him, great as the two world-halves, fame has come to be.

sanskrit: nū na̱ ehi̱ vārya̱m agne̍ gṛṇā̱na ā bha̍ra | ye va̱yaṁ ye ca̍ sū̱raya̍ḥ sva̱sti dhāma̍he̱ saco̱taidhi̍ pṛ̱tsu no̍ vṛ̱dhe ||
english: Come now, praised, O Agni, and bring the desirable thing; we who along with the lords set forth well-being together — and be present for our growth in battles.

sanskrit: ā ya̱jñair de̍va̱ martya̍ i̱tthā tavyā̍ṁsam ū̱taye̍ | a̱gniṁ kṛ̱te sva̍dhva̱re pū̱rur ī̍ḻī̱tāva̍se ||
english: With sacrifices, O god, the mortal in this way, for the aid of the mightier — Pūru would invoke Agni at the good rite, with the deed done, for protection.

sanskrit: asya̱ hi svaya̍śastara ā̱sā vi̍dharma̱n manya̍se | taṁ nāka̍ṁ ci̱traśo̍ciṣam ma̱ndram pa̱ro ma̍nī̱ṣayā̍ ||
english: For of this one you think more self-gloriously in the mouth by virtue of his dispensation; him the exhilarating one of variegated flame, surpassing by his vision.

sanskrit: a̱sya vāsā u̍ a̱rciṣā̱ ya āyu̍kta tu̱jā gi̱rā | di̱vo na yasya̱ reta̍sā bṛ̱hac choca̍nty a̱rcaya̍ḥ ||
english: Clothed in this one's flame is he who is harnessed with swift song; his flames blaze greatly like the seed of heaven.

sanskrit: a̱sya kratvā̱ vice̍taso da̱smasya̱ vasu̱ ratha̱ ā | adhā̱ viśvā̍su̱ havyo̱ 'gnir vi̱kṣu pra śa̍syate ||
english: By the will of this discerning, wondrous one, the wealth is on the chariot; therefore Agni the invocable is praised forth in all the clans.

sanskrit: nū na̱ id dhi vārya̍m ā̱sā sa̍canta sū̱raya̍ḥ | ūrjo̍ napād a̱bhiṣṭa̍ye pā̱hi śa̱gdhi sva̱staya̍ u̱taidhi̍ pṛ̱tsu no̍ vṛ̱dhe ||
english: Now the lords attend upon the desirable thing with their mouths; O grandson of strength, for the conquest protect us, be capable of well-being, and be present for our growth in battles.

sanskrit: prā̱tar a̱gniḥ pu̍rupri̱yo vi̱śaḥ sta̍ve̱tāti̍thiḥ | viśvā̍ni̱ yo ama̍rtyo ha̱vyā marte̍ṣu̱ raṇya̍ti ||
english: At dawn, Agni, much beloved, the guest, would be praised by the clans; the immortal one who delights in all oblations among mortals.

sanskrit: dvi̱tāya̍ mṛ̱ktavā̍hase̱ svasya̱ dakṣa̍sya ma̱ṁhanā̍ | indu̱ṁ sa dha̍tta ānu̱ṣak sto̱tā ci̍t te amartya ||
english: To the second one, the carrier of cleansed drops, by the generosity of his own discernment — he places the Soma drop continuously; even the praiser is yours, O immortal.

sanskrit: taṁ vo̍ dī̱rghāyu̍śociṣaṁ gi̱rā hu̍ve ma̱ghonā̍m | ari̍ṣṭo̱ yeṣā̱ṁ ratho̱ vy a̍śvadāva̱nn īya̍te ||
english: Him of long-lived flame I invoke with song for the generous ones; the chariot of those whose chariot goes unharmed, O horse-giver, goes forth.

sanskrit: ci̱trā vā̱ yeṣu̱ dīdhi̍tir ā̱sann u̱kthā pānti̱ ye | stī̱rṇam ba̱rhiḥ sva̍rṇare̱ śravā̍ṁsi dadhire̱ pari̍ ||
english: Among those in whom a variegated vision has been, the recitations protect; with the sacred grass strewn, O he-of-the-sun-felly, they have placed fame all around.

sanskrit: ye me̍ pañcā̱śata̍ṁ da̱dur aśvā̍nāṁ sa̱dhastu̍ti | dyu̱mad a̍gne̱ mahi̱ śravo̍ bṛ̱hat kṛ̍dhi ma̱ghonā̍ṁ nṛ̱vad a̍mṛta nṛ̱ṇām ||
english: Those who have given me fifty horses with the joint praise — O Agni, make great and brilliant fame for those generous men; O immortal, make it manly for the men.

sanskrit: a̱bhy a̍va̱sthāḥ pra jā̍yante̱ pra va̱vrer va̱vriś ci̍keta | u̱pasthe̍ mā̱tur vi ca̍ṣṭe ||
english: The stations are born in advance; the cover is perceived as a cover; he looks out in the lap of the mother.

sanskrit: ju̱hu̱re vi ci̱taya̱nto 'ni̍miṣaṁ nṛ̱mṇam pā̍nti | ā dṛ̱ḻhām pura̍ṁ viviśuḥ ||
english: They have offered into the fire, illuminating, guarding the manly power without blinking; they have entered the firm stronghold.

sanskrit: ā śvai̍tre̱yasya̍ ja̱ntavo̍ dyu̱mad va̍rdhanta kṛ̱ṣṭaya̍ḥ | ni̱ṣkagrī̍vo bṛ̱hadu̍ktha e̱nā madhvā̱ na vā̍ja̱yuḥ ||
english: The living beings of Śvaitreya have grown brilliantly, the peoples; with necklace at the throat, of lofty praise — like one who seeks the prize with this honey.

sanskrit: pri̱yaṁ du̱gdhaṁ na kāmya̱m ajā̍mi jā̱myoḥ sacā̍ | gha̱rmo na vāja̍jaṭha̱ro 'da̍bdha̱ḥ śaśva̍to̱ dabha̍ḥ ||
english: Like dear desirable milk — the non-kin together with the two kin; like the caldron of the prize-belly, undeceived, the ever-present deceiver.

sanskrit: krīḻa̍n no raśma̱ ā bhu̍va̱ḥ sam bhasma̍nā vā̱yunā̱ vevi̍dānaḥ | tā a̍sya san dhṛ̱ṣajo̱ na ti̱gmāḥ susa̍ṁśitā va̱kṣyo̍ vakṣaṇe̱sthāḥ ||
english: Playing, the rein has come to us, finding out together with the dusty wind; these sharp and bold ones of his, well-whetted, stand on the chest and at the breast.

sanskrit: yam a̍gne vājasātama̱ tvaṁ ci̱n manya̍se ra̱yim | taṁ no̍ gī̱rbhiḥ śra̱vāyya̍ṁ deva̱trā pa̍nayā̱ yuja̍m ||
english: Whatever wealth, O Agni, most gainful of prizes, even you consider — that companion of ours, worthy of renown, cause to be heard through our songs among the gods.

sanskrit: ye a̍gne̱ neraya̍nti te vṛ̱ddhā u̱grasya̱ śava̍saḥ | apa̱ dveṣo̱ apa̱ hvaro̱ 'nyavra̍tasya saścire ||
english: Those who do not lead toward you, O Agni, the increased ones of fierce strength — let enmity and crookedness of him of alien vow depart, they have followed.

sanskrit: hotā̍raṁ tvā vṛṇīma̱he 'gne̱ dakṣa̍sya̱ sādha̍nam | ya̱jñeṣu̍ pū̱rvyaṁ gi̱rā praya̍svanto havāmahe ||
english: We choose you as Hotṛ, O Agni, the accomplisher of discernment; we invoke you with libation and song, the ancient at the sacrifices.

sanskrit: i̱tthā yathā̍ ta ū̱taye̱ saha̍sāvan di̱ve-di̍ve | rā̱ya ṛ̱tāya̍ sukrato̱ gobhi̍ḥ ṣyāma sadha̱mādo̍ vī̱raiḥ syā̍ma sadha̱māda̍ḥ ||
english: Thus as for your aid, O powerful one, day by day — for wealth, for Ṛta, O of good will, may we be co-rejoicers with cows, may we be co-rejoicers with heroes.

sanskrit: ma̱nu̱ṣvat tvā̱ ni dhī̍mahi manu̱ṣvat sam i̍dhīmahi | agne̍ manu̱ṣvad a̍ṅgiro de̱vān de̍vaya̱te ya̍ja ||
english: Like Manu, we set you in place; like Manu, we kindle you; O Agni, like Manu, O Aṅgiras, sacrifice to the gods for the devout one.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hi mānu̍ṣe̱ jane 'gne̱ suprī̍ta i̱dhyase̍ | sruca̍s tvā yanty ānu̱ṣak sujā̍ta̱ sarpi̍rāsute ||
english: For you, O Agni, are kindled well-pleased among human folk; the ladles come to you continuously, O nobly-born one, with ghee poured out.

sanskrit: tvāṁ viśve̍ sa̱joṣa̍so de̱vāso̍ dū̱tam a̍krata | sa̱pa̱ryanta̍s tvā kave ya̱jñeṣu̍ de̱vam ī̍ḻate ||
english: All the gods of one accord have made you the messenger; honoring you, O seer, they invoke you as a god at the sacrifices.

sanskrit: de̱vaṁ vo̍ devaya̱jyayā̱gnim ī̍ḻīta̱ martya̍ḥ | sami̍ddhaḥ śukra dīdihy ṛ̱tasya̱ yoni̱m āsa̍daḥ sa̱sasya̱ yoni̱m āsa̍daḥ ||
english: Through the worship of the gods let the mortal invoke Agni as a god; blazing, O bright one, shine; you have sat in the womb of Ṛta, you have sat in the womb of the grain.

sanskrit: pra vi̍śvasāmann atri̱vad arcā̍ pāva̱kaśo̍ciṣe | yo a̍dhva̱reṣv īḍyo̱ hotā̍ ma̱ndrata̍mo vi̱śi ||
english: Sing forth, O Viśvasāman, like Atri, to the one of purifying flame; who is the invocable Hotṛ, the most exhilarating, in the clan at the rites.

sanskrit: ny a1̱̍gniṁ jā̱tave̍dasa̱ṁ dadhā̍tā de̱vam ṛ̱tvija̍m | pra ya̱jña e̍tv ānu̱ṣag a̱dyā de̱vavya̍castamaḥ ||
english: Set down Agni Jātavedas as the divine seasonal priest; let the sacrifice proceed continuously today — he who sees most widely to the gods.

sanskrit: ci̱ki̱tvinma̍nasaṁ tvā de̱vam martā̍sa ū̱taye̍ | vare̍ṇyasya̱ te 'va̍sa iyā̱nāso̍ amanmahi ||
english: You the god of knowing mind, the mortals invoke for aid; going toward the protection of your excellent one, we have thought of you.

sanskrit: agne̍ ciki̱ddhy a1̱̍sya na̍ i̱daṁ vaca̍ḥ sahasya | taṁ tvā̍ suśipra dampate̱ stomai̍r vardha̱nty atra̍yo gī̱rbhiḥ śu̍mbha̱nty atra̍yaḥ ||
english: O Agni, attend to this word of ours, O powerful one; you, O lord of the household of fair jaw, the Atris increase with hymns of praise; the Atris adorn you with their songs.
